name: Pink RN Caduceus Lifeline Heart Vinyl Decal
seoTitle: Pink RN Car Decal with Caduceus and Heartbeat
metaDescription: A pink registered nurse vinyl decal with a caduceus and heartbeat line for a car, wall, or window. A cheerful, budget friendly gift for proud RNs.
summary: A pink RN decal with a caduceus and lifeline heart, an easy way for a proud registered nurse to show her title on her car or window.
whyItWorks: Plenty of nurses love a little public pride in their work, and the car is where it shows up most. A rear window decal greets her every time she walks out to the parking garage after a 12 hour shift, which is a nice small boost at seven in the morning. The pink color and heartbeat line keep it friendly rather than clinical, and the RN letters make it clear what she worked so hard to earn.

Decals are a great match for graduation season. They slip flat inside a card, mail easily, and celebrate the license in a way she will see daily. The title lists cars, trucks, vans, walls, and windows, so it can also go on a home office window or a mirror. Pair it with a badge reel or scrub cap in a matching shade of pink for a coordinated gift.
goodToKnow: The listed size is 7.5 x 4.1 inches, so measure the window or surface if space is tight.
Vinyl decals usually go on smooth, clean surfaces, so check the listing for application tips.
It is made for registered nurses, so pick another design for LPNs or CNAs.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing school graduate?
faq.a: Yes, it is a budget friendly way to celebrate the new RN title, and it fits flat inside a graduation card.

faq.q: Can it go somewhere other than a car?
faq.a: The listing mentions walls and windows as well as vehicles, so a mirror or window at home can work. Check the listing for surface recommendations before applying.
